integrity: Exact finite proof is given by the complete standalone rational/integer enumeration, twice in structurally distinct ways. The 104 three-input threshold function count is classical and not claimed as new. Same-model review only; no independent validation.
limitations: The exact polynomial concerns the centered four-cube and Bernoulli vertex retention only. It is a center-membership law, not an interior-membership, all-dimensional, or asymptotic threshold theorem. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Exact center-retention polynomial for vertex-thinned four-cubes
